#pragma warning disable CS0612, CS0618 // Only generated code calls GeneratedCode.

// In the global namespace, which every file reaches: LocalizableText.Inline then binds however a call names
// the type, also by its full name in a file without a using for its namespace.

/// <summary>
/// Writes texts in every language of this assembly's <see cref="CodeChops.Idioma.SupportedLanguagesAttribute"/>.
/// </summary>
[Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.EmbeddedAttribute]
internal static class GeneratedLocalizableText
{
    // The languages, the default first, as the package picks one of them by its position. One array for
    // every call, which the package tells apart by reference.
    private static readonly string[] Languages = ["en", "nl", "de"];

    extension(CodeChops.Idioma.LocalizableText)
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// A text in every language this assembly supports: <c>LocalizableText.Inline(en: "...", nl: "...", de: "...")</c>.
        /// It gives the wording for the current UI culture. A culture that none of them serves gets the wording in the app's
        /// default language, else the <c>en</c> wording.
        /// </summary>
        /// <remarks>
        /// Name each argument after its language. An unnamed one is a build error (<c>LOC501</c>), because two swapped languages
        /// would go unnoticed. To include a value, write it into every language, as in <c>$"Hello, {name}!"</c>.
        /// The string holds the wording of the moment it's made, so call this where you show the text.
        /// </remarks>
        /// <param name="en">The wording in <c>en</c>.</param>
        /// <param name="nl">The wording in <c>nl</c>.</param>
        /// <param name="de">The wording in <c>de</c>.</param>
        public static string Inline(string en, string nl, string de)
        {
            return CodeChops.Idioma.Internals.GeneratedCode.FindLanguage(Languages) switch
            {
                1 => nl ?? throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(nl)),
                2 => de ?? throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(de)),
                _ => en ?? throw new System.ArgumentNullException(nameof(en)),
            };
        }
    }
}
#nullable restore
